title: coleus carnosifolius
intro: Coleus carnosifolius, commonly known as the "meadow coleus" or "Himalayan Coleus", is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus carnosifolius include its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent and its potential use in treating fever and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Coleus carnosifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
